title: kit's tpa
description: Simple TPA for Paper: request teleports, accept/deny/cancel, delay on teleport, cancel if you move. Multilingual with KitLanguagePlugin.
body:
Features
/tpa — ask to teleport to another player
/tpahere — ask another player to come to you
/tpaccept / /tpdeny — handle incoming requests
/tpacancel — cancel your outgoing request
Teleport delay after accept (configurable)
Cancel on move during the wait
Request timeout and cooldown (optional)
Multilingual messages with LanguagePlugin (English, Hebrew, French, Spanish)
Commands
Command	Description
/tpa <player>
Request to teleport to that player
/tpahere <player>
Request that player teleports to you
/tpaccept
Accept the latest incoming request
/tpdeny
Deny the latest incoming request
/tpacancel
Cancel your outgoing request
Language (optional): install LanguagePlugin and use:


/language english
/language hebrew
/language french
/language spanish
